categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the electronic components manufacturing industry, focusing on flexible copper clad laminates (FCCL), cover layers, adhesives, reinforcement boards, and composite boards. It also engages in wholesale and retail of industrial additives, chemical raw materials, and electronic materials. The business extends to semiconductor advanced packaging materials and high-end materials for AI servers and advanced mobile communication technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include chemical synthesis of polymer films, precision coating, high-temperature processing, and lamination equipment for producing flexible printed circuit board materials. The company develops high-frequency, high-speed, low-loss materials, high dimensional stability and ion migration resistant materials, and thick copper and insulation layers for fast charging applications. It also innovates in laser release adhesives and temporary bonding films for semiconductor advanced packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global manufacturers of smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearable devices, and automotive electronics. The company serves the upstream supply chain of flexible printed circuit board manufacturers and semiconductor packaging industries. Major end markets include consumer electronics, automotive electronics, AI servers, and advanced communication devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in the Greater China region, including Taiwan and Mainland China, with production bases in Taiwan, Mainland China, and Thailand. It has established global marketing and logistics centers to support customers worldwide, including Europe and other overseas markets. The Thailand plant started mass production in 2024 to enhance supply chain resilience.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the supply chain as a supplier of high-value electronic materials, specifically flexible copper clad laminates and semiconductor packaging materials, which are essential raw materials for downstream flexible printed circuit board manufacturers and semiconductor packaging companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic R&D focuses on developing high-frequency, high-speed, low-loss materials for 5G and AI applications, ultra-thin and high dimensional stability materials, and advanced semiconductor packaging adhesives. The company emphasizes collaboration with customers and academic institutions to accelerate innovation. It also prioritizes ESG initiatives, including green energy investments, waste reduction, and sustainable product design.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electronic materials, including flexible copper clad laminates, cover layers, adhesives, and semiconductor packaging materials. The company also benefits from licensing and strategic partnerships but mainly relies on direct sales to global electronics manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a global leader in flexible copper clad laminate materials with an estimated 15-20% market share worldwide. Major competitors include Japanese firms such as Nippon Steel and Arisawa, Korean companies like Doosan, and Taiwanese firms such as Unimicron. The company maintains competitive advantages through scale, supply chain management, and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately NT$9.94 billion, a 21.9% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to the parent company rising by 40.1%. The company has shown steady growth driven by new product development and increased market share. It maintains a strong financial position with total assets of NT$14.53 billion and equity of NT$10.67 billion as of the latest fiscal year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-value, technologically advanced electronic materials tailored for high-frequency, high-speed transmission and fine-line circuit applications. Its competitive differentiation lies in superior material properties, strong R&D capabilities, close collaboration with customers for specification development, and a resilient global supply chain. Additionally, it emphasizes sustainable manufacturing and ESG compliance to meet evolving customer and regulatory demands.
